Cloudflare DNS records for website email

1. Edit the existing SPF record (do not add a second SPF record)
Type: TXT
Name: @
Content: v=spf1 ip4:91.98.16.56 include:_spf.mx.cloudflare.net ~all

2. Add the DKIM signing record
Type: TXT
Name: website2026._domainkey
Content: v=DKIM1; h=sha256; k=rsa; 

Keep the existing MX records. Confirm the Email Routing rule for info@delicent.nl points to your verified destination inbox.

Verified on 21 November 2026. Website notifications are enabled; Cloudflare accepted the live form test for info@delicent.nl. Final Gmail inbox arrival remains to be confirmed by the mailbox owner.
